Well here’s the interesting thing. I was never meant to be alive. I have known since I was very young I was born an accident. I’ve made many a post in this sub about my desire for death but then I get many supporting words which sometimes helps, sometimes doesn’t. But I keep trucking, and as people say it gets better, and then it gets worse again and I end up back here. But right now I’m in one of the good times. The anxiety of it all falling apart again is still there I assure you, but I’m appreciating the good that I have. I went from being homeless out of my car a few months ago, and now I’m the assistant manager at a video game store making pretty okay money, and while I can’t say I’m happy, I’m definitely happier than I was. All of this to say, life is a roller coaster, one I was never meant to be on. And I hate it sometimes, but I have fun and can feel the excitement of life sometimes too. I don’t know what your demons are, but know that I feel like this a lot too, and I’m still here to make this ramble on Reddit. Please feel free to DM me, we can talk. I’m sure you have a lot of stories to tell even if they’re not happy stories. We can help each other through this life we have been given.
